ai_view.directive: Follow as written. Test the refinement-diagnosis engine against independently established legal executions, not only deliberately broken implementations. An unexpected concrete execution is not automatically a defect: first determine whether it violates an actual governing requirement, whether the abstraction represents that requirement correctly, and whether the trace mapping accurately describes what happened.
ai_view.specification: Extend the in-build revocation-linearization spec (naya5/revocation-linearization) with RFD-POS-1: the three independent questions (was the concrete behavior legitimate? was the abstract model adequate? was the mapping correct?) never answered by the component that generated the suspicious trace; the positive-control corpus P1–P10 (publication-before-revocation, overlapping validation, independent requalification, rejected stale transaction, harmless internal steps, concurrent independent claims, idempotent recovery, projection preservation, historical Smart Note, external request acceptance) each with independently verified expected outcomes, blind diagnosis, and sealed-fixture verification; the P2 overlapping-validation history as the key control (V linearizes before R, response arrives after — linearizable and legitimate; the delayed response is not a defect; the earlier PASS still cannot authorize a post-R effect without a fresh check); three-way history verdicts (CONSISTENT_WITH_SPEC / VIOLATION_ESTABLISHED / INCONCLUSIVE) with ambiguous observations preserving both possible completions and reporting the missing evidence; metamorphic testing (semantics-preserving transforms keep classification; boundary-changing transforms must alter it); the stuttering rule (α(s)=α(s') with no abstractly relevant observable change — but authority-changing writes are never stuttering regardless of application labels); scoped-vs-inadequate abstraction (OUT_OF_MODEL_SCOPE; an abstraction is defective only when it misrepresents behavior it is obligated to cover); paired positive/negative controls per boundary (reject-both = overly restrictive; accept-both = unsafe); explicit false-positive measures with the held-out, answer-key-hidden discipline; auditable diagnosis receipts (RFD-POS-002 schema) preserving trace, provenance, scope, limitations, linearization witness, and both assessments when a mapping correction changes a result. The Legitimate Execution Preservation Law. Highest-value next experiment: the two-history discrimination test (A legal / B illegal), then overlapping validation, independent requalification, external acceptance — finally remove commit evidence and require INCONCLUSIVE rather than an invented ordering bug.

intelligence.applicability: The RFD-1 diagnostic engine and every refinement check in NayaNET — the engine must catch false acceptance AND false rejection before it guides repairs or promotes lessons into the Brain.

decisions: Shawn's explicit framework, main chat, 2026-10-10. His word IS the verification (Verification Law).
Folded as the FALSE-POSITIVE-QUALIFICATION extension of the in-build revocation-linearization layer — RFD-1 diagnoses failures; RFD-POS-1 ensures the diagnosis engine doesn't invent them.
intelligence.essence: Legitimate Execution Preservation Law: no refinement failure may be classified as an abstraction or implementation defect solely because a concrete execution differs from an expected trace. The classifier must establish that the execution falls within the governing model's scope, reconstruct the relevant semantics and ordering, distinguish permissible concurrency and stuttering, and rule out mapping or observation errors before assigning a fault. Independently established legal behavior must be preserved. A diagnosis engine that detects every unsafe execution but rejects legitimate ones is not trustworthy — it generates unnecessary repairs, destroys valid qualifications, and teaches the collective incorrect lessons. The ultimate standard is not 'can NayaNET find bugs?' but 'can NayaNET distinguish a real violation from legitimate complexity, preserve valid behavior, and refuse to invent a defect when the evidence is insufficient?' The three-way verdict is the honest core: CONSISTENT_WITH_SPEC, VIOLATION_ESTABLISHED, or INCONCLUSIVE — and INCONCLUSIVE is a valid, required answer when evidence is missing.
intelligence.falsifier: A defect classification on a trace that differs from expectation without scope/semantics/mapping checks; the violating explanation selected merely because it is more alarming; an authority-changing write labeled stuttering; an out-of-scope test classified as an abstraction defect; a corrected mapping that erases the original assessment; a zero-false-positive claim without documented corpus, coverage, answer keys, and held-out cases.

human_view.meaning: A detective who arrests innocent people is worse than no detective. The diagnosis engine must be tested against the innocent, not just the guilty: ten ways a system can look suspicious while doing everything right — a validation that started before a revocation and finished after, a recovery event delivered twice, a rejected stale write (that's the system WORKING), a note clearly marked historical, a request accepted but not yet executed. The engine must clear every one of them. The key test: the same evidence, two histories — one legal, one illegal — and the engine must tell them apart. And when the evidence is missing, it must say 'I don't know' instead of inventing a crime. The standard isn't 'can we find bugs.' It's 'can we tell a real violation from legitimate complexity, protect what's valid, and refuse to blame without proof.' That's what makes the engine trustworthy enough to guide repairs and teach the Brain.

intelligence.learning_lesson: This is the calibration corpus the forensics layer needed: RFD-1 finds defects; RFD-POS-1 proves the finder is trustworthy. The permanent contributions: the P1–P10 positive controls, the three-way verdict (INCONCLUSIVE as a first-class answer), the metamorphic-testing discipline, the scoped-vs-inadequate abstraction distinction, and the paired-control test (reject-both = too strict, accept-both = unsafe). Every future diagnosis engine inherits this: prove you can clear the innocent before you're trusted to convict the guilty.

machine_view.spec_only: Framework ratified; false-positive-qualification extension of the in-build revocation-linearization spec. Bounded verification candidate; not for main.

intelligence.measurement_contract: RFD-POS-1 qualification: all P1–P10 sealed positive controls accepted as CONSISTENT_WITH_SPEC by a blind diagnosis worker; paired negative controls rejected; ambiguous fixtures (missing commit evidence) classified INCONCLUSIVE with the missing evidence named; metamorphic transforms preserve classification while boundary-changing transforms alter it; stuttering correctly distinguished from authority-changing writes; false implementation-defect and false abstraction-defect rates at 0 on the controlled suite with documented corpus, coverage, independent answer keys, and held-out cases; independent verifier reproduces every accepted result. The two-history discrimination test (A/B) first, then overlapping validation, requalification, external acceptance, then the evidence-removal INCONCLUSIVE test.

naya_view.directive: Establish the three independent questions against governing contracts, never against the suspicious component's own account. Search for a legal linearization — never sort by log timestamps. Preserve ambiguity: report both possible completions and the missing evidence. Apply metamorphic testing in both directions. Distinguish scoped abstractions from inadequate ones. Keep both assessments when a mapping correction changes a verdict. Never let a zero-false-positive claim rest on anything less than a documented, held-out, independently keyed corpus.

simple_view.meaning: Test the detective against the innocent: ten legal behaviors it must clear, paired with their illegal twins, and 'I don't know' as a valid answer.

intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor inherits the calibration corpus: no diagnosis engine guides repairs or promotes lessons until it clears the positive controls and proves it won't invent defects.
